market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $2,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at $2,330 on May 7, 2026; reported May range $2,230-$2,415. To dip to $2,000 in May, needs another ~10% drop from May low and ~14% from current. Crypto downside vol is non-negligible but no current catalyst; analyst May target ranges cluster $2,250-$2,550. Market 0.265 looks slightly rich.
